_description: Critical data flows and contracts that MUST be verified on every PR. The AI regression detector uses this manifest to catch regressions before merge.

frozen_files._description: Files that must NEVER be modified without CTO approval

critical_data_flows.name: Profile Location Display
critical_data_flows.description: User profile must show full location (city, state/region, country) not just country
critical_data_flows.priority_rule: talent_profiles.location is preferred over users.location. Location must include city+state+country when available, never truncate to just country.
regression_examples: Location shows 'United States' instead of 'Roswell, Georgia, United States'
Location field returns null when talent_profiles.location exists
Country used instead of full location string

critical_data_flows.name: Years of Experience Calculation
critical_data_flows.description: Experience years must be calculated from actual work history (experience table startDate), NOT a hardcoded number
critical_data_flows.calculation: Earliest experience.startDate subtracted from now, converted to years, rounded to 1 decimal
regression_examples: Shows '19 years' when work history only spans 5 years
Shows hardcoded '5 years of experience' instead of calculated value
yearsOfExperience field missing from API response
Frontend ignores API yearsOfExperience and uses stale user.yearsOfExperience column

critical_data_flows.name: Profile Data Loading
critical_data_flows.description: Profile page must load all user data without blank sections or loading spinners stuck
regression_examples: Profile shows loading spinner forever
Skills section empty despite user having skills
Experience section missing
API returns 500 due to missing relation join

critical_data_flows.name: Talent Search/Browse Cards
critical_data_flows.description: Talent browse page cards must show all data fields correctly
regression_examples: Cards show $0/hr rate
Skills badges missing
Avatar not loading (signed URL regression)

critical_data_flows.name: Authentication Flow
critical_data_flows.description: Login/signup must work for both client and talent accounts via email and OAuth
regression_examples: Login redirects to wrong page
JWT token not persisted
OAuth callback fails
Role-based redirects broken

critical_data_flows.name: Offer Negotiation Flow
critical_data_flows.description: Full offer lifecycle: create, counter, accept, reject with state machine
regression_examples: Cannot counter an offer
Accepted offer still shows action buttons
State transition validation bypassed

critical_data_flows.name: Project Listings CRUD
critical_data_flows.description: Create, edit, publish, unpublish project listings
regression_examples: Draft not saving
Published listing showing draft data
File uploads failing
Categories/skills not persisting

critical_data_flows.name: Signed URL / Avatar / File Display
critical_data_flows.description: All R2 stored files must display via signed URLs, blurred versions for non-authenticated
regression_examples: Avatars showing broken image
Signed URL expired immediately
Blurred overlay not showing for locked content

security_sprint_breakage_patterns._description: Common ways security hardening breaks existing features. The AI regression detector MUST check all of these when a PR is authored by a security sprint engineer.

guard_and_middleware_changes.description: New or modified guards/middleware can block legitimate authenticated requests
regression_examples: New global guard rejects valid JWT tokens
Rate limiter blocks normal user activity
CORS middleware rejects Vercel preview URLs
Helmet headers break file downloads or iframe embeds
New middleware throws on missing optional header, returning 500 instead of proceeding

dto_validation_tightening.description: Stricter DTO validation can reject requests that worked before
regression_examples: New @IsNotEmpty() on a field that frontend sends as empty string
New @MaxLength() shorter than existing stored data
New @IsEnum() on a field that accepts freeform text
New required field that existing clients do not send
Validation pipe now rejects requests that previously passed (400 errors on working forms)

response_sanitization.description: Stripping fields from API responses breaks frontend consumers
regression_examples: Serialization interceptor strips fields the frontend reads (email, phone, location)
ClassSerializerInterceptor with @Exclude() hides data the frontend needs
Response DTO maps fewer fields than before
Sensitive field removal also removes non-sensitive fields by accident

error_handling_changes.description: Changed error shapes or status codes break frontend error handlers
regression_examples: Error response shape changed (frontend expects { message } but now gets { error })
Status code changed (401 instead of 403, or 403 instead of 404)
New exception filter swallows original error details
Generic 500 replaces specific 4xx that frontend handles

encryption_and_hashing.description: Changing encryption or hashing algorithms can make stored data unreadable
regression_examples: Password hash algorithm changed, existing users cannot log in
Encryption key rotation without re-encrypting stored data (E2EE incident precedent)
Token format changed, existing refresh tokens invalidated
New signing algorithm on JWT, existing tokens rejected

database_changes.description: Security-related schema changes can break queries or lose data
regression_examples: New NOT NULL constraint on column that has existing NULL rows
Column type change breaks existing queries
New unique constraint conflicts with existing duplicate data
Index changes slow down queries that were fast before

api_contracts._description: Backend API response shapes that frontend depends on. Changes to these MUST be flagged.

component_contracts._description: Frontend component props that must not lose data fields

layout_frozen_patterns._description: UI patterns that must NEVER be changed when wiring data or adding content
rules: NEVER change HTML structure, CSS classes, grid layouts, or hover effects when wiring data
ONLY replace static text/placeholders with dynamic data
Storybook is the source of truth for layouts
NEVER use em dashes in website copy
